## Learning goals

- implement a centred moving average;
- fit classical decomposition and read panels.

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```

## 1. Implement a 3-MA

```{r}
ma3 <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  for (t in 2:(n - 1)) out[t] <- mean(x[(t - 1):(t + 1)])
  out
}
ma3(c(5, 6, 8, 7, 9))  # expect 7 at position 3
```

## 2. Classical decomp

```{r}
aus_production |>
  model(classical_decomposition(Beer, type = "additive")) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot()
```
